description: Single actor filmography query sorted by rating and popularity

query: Movies where Leonardo DiCaprio and Kate Winslet worked together
description: Multi-person co-star intersection requiring COUNT(DISTINCT) = 2
gold_sql: WITH matched_people AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT person_id, name FROM people WHERE name IN ('Leonardo DiCaprio', 'Kate Winslet')), shared_titles AS (SELECT c.title_id FROM matched_people p JOIN crew_lookup c ON c.person_id = p.person_id WHERE c.category IN ('actor', 'actress') GROUP BY c.title_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.name) = 2) SELECT t.title_id, t.primary_title, t.premiered, t.genres, r.rating, r.votes, t.poster_path FROM shared_titles s JOIN titles t ON t.title_id = s.title_id AND t.type IN ('movie', 'tvMovie') LEFT JOIN ratings r ON r.title_id = t.title_id ORDER BY r.rating DESC NULLS LAST, r.votes DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 100;
